levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The timed response omits a key fact or the core request entirely.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The timed response states the key facts and request, though wording is rough.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The timed response is clear and complete despite the time limit.

criteria.dimension: Meaningful comparison to the unhurried version

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The comparison notes only wording polish, with no substantive difference identified.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names a real substantive difference beyond wording (such as an omitted detail or reordered priority).

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names a substantive difference and explains why the pressure caused it.

criteria.dimension: Self-awareness about what held up and what slipped

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Claims nothing slipped, or the response is vague.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Honestly names one thing that held up and one that slipped.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names specific, believable examples of both, grounded in the actual timed draft.

lookFors: The timed draft, even if rough, contains the core who/what/by-when facts.
The comparison identifies a genuine content or structural difference, not just tone.
The self-awareness response is honest, including admitting something slipped, without self-criticism.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
